spells.name: Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack
spells.description: Briar leaps and enters a Blood Frenzy, self-taunting to the nearest enemy for seconds, prioritizing Champions. While in Blood Frenzy she gains % Attack Speed and % Move Speed, and her Attacks deal physical damage to enemies surrounding her target. Briar can Recast this Ability to empower her next Attack. It deals + % missing Health physical damage and heals Briar for + % of the damage dealt.
spells.coverageNote: Blood Frenzy grants timed attack speed and repeated surrounding attack damage. The source is assigned to the timed-on-hit family, but a complete reviewed binding has not been compiled yet.

spells.name: Chilling Scream
spells.description: Begin Charging: Briar removes Blood Frenzy and gathers energy, gaining % damage reduction and restoring Health over 1 second. Release: Briar unleashes a scream that deals up to magic damage based on time charged, and Slows by % for seconds. When fully charged, the scream Knocks Back enemies, dealing magic damage to those who hit a wall and Stunning them for seconds.

spells.name: Certain Death
spells.description: Briar kicks her pillory's hemolith gemstone and flies to the location of the first champion it hits, marking them as her prey. On landing, she deals magic damage to everything nearby and causes enemies who are not her prey to Flee for seconds. She then enters an empowered Blood Frenzy and will pursue her prey until death. During this time, she gains Armor and Magic Resist, % Lifesteal, and an additional % Move Speed.
